citations.assessment: The digital Yerushalmi gives an unnamed host, and Rav Yehudah is the transmitter in the name of Abba bar bar Hana. It reads Bar Kappara, while Heilprin’s printed name is Bar Kapta. Preserve the edition’s folio and flag the witness difference in the reader.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
